consultant.label: Consultant / technical
consultant.headline: APO-DG2-PRO: architecture fit and trade-off view
consultant.pitch: Use this view to test whether conferencing is genuinely part of the requirement. If the room does not need camera, microphone, speakerphone or USB collaboration, there may be cleaner product paths.
consultant.value: Helps separate a technically possible product choice from the strongest design choice for the application, budget, risk and future expansion.
talkTrack: Validate the application first, then decide whether this product family is the cleanest architecture.

Use the specification as evidence after the room workflow and signal architecture are clear.
